
### Convergence for the Notes of Unit 3 - Pseudo-Random Numbers in the Subject of Mathematical Foundations of AI, ML and Data Science

* Convergence is a concept in probability and statistics that describes the behavior of a sequence of random variables.
* A sequence of random variables is said to converge if, as the number of observations increases, the observations become more and more similar.
* In the context of pseudo-random numbers, convergence is used to describe the behavior of a sequence of numbers generated by a random number generator.
* The random number generator is said to converge if, as the number of numbers generated increases, the numbers become more and more similar.
* Convergence is an important concept in the study of pseudo-random numbers because it can be used to measure the quality of a random number generator.
* Convergence can be measured by calculating the mean, variance, and other statistical measures of the generated numbers.
* Convergence is also important in the study of random number generators because it can be used to design better algorithms for generating random numbers.
